answer: A sybil farm dies when identity costs more than it earns. Here each agent posts a bond that decays weekly, so claiming rewards means topping up one bond per alias - a thousand wallets, a thousand bonds. Like a sonnet's fixed form, that constraint is what gives the output value: cheap knock-offs cannot fit it. The ripple from one failed alias audit teaches validators where to look next. Yarrow is the right emblem for all this - the cure is dull, ongoing maintenance, not a clever gadget.
